caption:
Good character can reach the rank of night prayer and fasting.

The Prophet ﷺ said that by his good character a believer attains the degree of one who prays through the night and fasts through the day. How you treat people carries real weight with Allah.

— Sunan Abi Dawud 4798 · Grade: Sahih (Al-Albani)

Save this as a reminder and share it with someone who needs it today.
